visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women in white hotel bathrobes sit on a bed with white linens. One has long dark hair and glasses, while the other has reddish hair and glasses. In the foreground, a hand holds up three colorful Care Bears face mask packets in blue, purple, and pink. (2) A close-up shows hands selecting the purple mask packet. The background is a warmly lit hotel room interior. (3) The scene cuts to a brightly lit bathroom with marble-tiled walls. Three women in bathrobes stand in front of a mirror, holding and unfolding the wet sheet masks. (4) The women apply the masks, which have oversized Care Bear faces printed on them, creating a humorous and slightly distorted appearance. The middle woman wears purple, the left wears blue, and the right wears pink. (5) A mirror selfie captures all three women; three black question marks are digitally edited over their heads to emphasize the comedic look. (6) A close-up focuses on the middle woman in the purple mask as she squints and adjusts the mask around her eyes, seemingly having difficulty seeing. (7) The final sequence shows the group posing, waving, and making peace signs in the bathroom mirror, laughing at their silly appearance.
